title: Normalize MAP role IDs with contracts and historical compatibility
description: Implement the approved TASK-277 role-semantics slice without rewriting history. Define a small stable role vocabulary and compact authority contracts, validate new tasks against it, map historical free-form values through compatibility mode, and make routing consume normalized roles instead of provider names or incidental prose.
acceptance_criteria: A registry defines five to seven stable role IDs with Mission, Owns, May, Must, Must not, Required input and output, Escalate, and Complete when contracts.
New task creation and schema validation reject unknown role IDs with a clear diagnostic.
Historical tasks remain loadable through an explicit compatibility mapping without rewriting their stored role history.
Runner decisions consume normalized roles and keep provider, model tier, worker identity, and capability requirements separate.
Focused compatibility and routing tests pass and the delivery note states why role normalization does not enforce review independence.
